page.layout: One page of running verse text, one column, with a rule and a centred letter heading "TAV." set between two passages. No margin notes. Printed page number top right, running head top left. Signature at foot right.

p.i: Semper nos columes credidimus fore, Aduersasque acies posse retundere: Victorum hic (trepidus dum fugit) hostium Sæuas incidit in manus.
Hutz,ô,culta soli pinguia quæ tenes: Quæ longis Solymæ fletibus exilis: Quam nunc festa iuuat gaudia carpere Prisci progenies Edom.
Te fors dura manet, prouida mox Dei Te mens luctificis cladibus impetet.
Non grata variis ludibrium vice Fies perdita plebibus:
Sorbebis rutili quum pateram meri, Vindex quam Superûm dextera porriget: Epotisque cades ebria facibus Nudatisque gemes probris.

main_text.p: CHARA Deo nuper soboles Solymæa parēti, Quæ nunc disjuncta patriis Finibus procul per orbem Totum, criminibus debita sustines Præmia fœdis, Ne desponde animum: Namque patris Cœlituum nota benignitas

page.notes: The large initial C of CHARA is decorative and is joined to the word. The rule above TAV. is a printed separator, not text. Faint show-through from the back of the leaf is ignored. Doubtful readings: "luctificis" (the scan shows a worn letter after "lu"), and the spelling "columes" in the first line, which may be a printing error for "columes" as printed.
